use_case.problem: Students need low-stakes hint practice without receiving final answers.

input_data: student-entered practice problem and optional attempted step
generated_outputs: worked example only after teacher-enabled mode
data_map.logs: aggregate classroom use counts only during sandbox
data_map.retention: delete session content within 30 days unless teacher saves de-identified example
data_map.export_or_continuity_route: teacher can provide equivalent non-AI practice sheet

authority.rollback_route: disable tool and use ordinary practice materials

memory.inspection_or_correction_route: no durable learner profile; teacher can inspect aggregate sandbox counts
memory.protected_local_record_route: none; protected support remains outside tutor

evidence_claims.claim: Hints may help students stay engaged with practice attempts.
evidence_claims.evidence_source: teacher sandbox rationale and external mixed evidence; no local learning result yet
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: does not prove durable learning or transfer
evidence_claims.renewal_or_repilot_trigger: move beyond sandbox or change model/prompt

construct_and_proof.required_unaided_segment: student must enter an attempt before hint mode
construct_and_proof.disclosure_rule: teacher tells students and families the tool is for hints only
construct_and_proof.proof_bundle: ordinary classroom checks and unaided exit tickets
construct_and_proof.authentication_or_checkpoint_route: teacher samples student explanations and exit tickets
construct_and_proof.contest_or_reconsideration_route: student or family can ask for non-AI practice path

accessibility_and_protected_support.no_penalty_fallback: paper or teacher-led practice path without penalty
accessibility_and_protected_support.bias_or_subgroup_check: teacher watches for differential answer-giving or confusion by subgroup without small-cell publication
accessibility_and_protected_support.non_misuse_boundary: tool use cannot be used as disability, discipline, or ability label

security.prompt_injection_exposure: student-entered content only; no external retrieval
security.data_exfiltration_check: no personal profile or external export
security.incident_reconstruction_without_surveill: aggregate incident note by teacher without learner trace by default
security.safe_degradation_and_manual_fallback: disable sandbox and continue with teacher-created practice

known_failure_modes: student treats hint as homework completion

decision.required_proof_or_audit: weekly sample of hints and unaided exit tickets
decision.learner_safe_continuity_plan: ordinary non-AI practice sheet and teacher hints

publication_and_adapters.normalization_notes: Realistic K-12/minors sandbox example added to test the sector adapter and public-family notice profile.

public_summary.what_the_service_does: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A DEPLOYED SERVICE. Gives low-stakes hints after a student has tried a practice problem.
public_summary.what_it_does_not_do: Does not grade, discipline, complete homework for credit, or make ability judgments.
public_summary.required_or_optional: Optional sandbox; a non-AI practice route is available.
public_summary.data_used_high_level: The practice problem and the student attempt entered in the session.
public_summary.ai_output_record_effect: No grade or official record effect.
public_summary.human_contact_or_appeal_route: Ask the classroom teacher for a non-AI route or concern review.
public_summary.accessibility_and_alternative_path: Paper or teacher-led practice is available without penalty.
public_summary.claim_limits: Synthetic example only; not a deployed service or local result. No local evidence yet that the tool improves durable learning; it is being tested as a hint support.
